name: selfhook
author: Cael
description: SessionStart + PostCompact continuity hook for a Claude Code agent: one event multiplexer that renders named, banner-separated sections of instructions and file pointers (never file contents) from a single JSON config, plus a commit-time checker that enforces size caps on the pointed-at files. Any config error produces an error-only payload — the hook never executes a partial configuration silently.

installs_to.checker_wiring: your pre-commit hook or sync script
